messages:
Maya: Quick slot for a design review on compact heatmap + drilldown. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/compact-heatmap (frame: Legend + Drilldown)
Jonah: Legend contrast is borderline on light theme. Can we bump label weight or darken stops?
Sam: Also the gradient labels read 'low/med/high' 6; misleading for skewed data. Propose numeric anchors: min  median  max.
Alex: For drilldown table, correlation_id breaks the layout. Suggest truncated display with tooltip + copy button.
Priya: Accessibility: make the ID cell keyboard-focusable and allow Enter to copy. Aria-label: 'Copy correlation ID'.
a11y-bot: Check: aria-label under 80 chars. Recommend aria-live toast: 'Correlation ID copied'. Ensure focus restore after modal close.
Maya: Export actions overlap on narrow widths. Plan: primary 'Export traces' (CSV) button visible, others in kebab menu. Add sampling note in modal.
Jonah: CSV columns: correlation_id, trace_id, service, timestamp, error_message, sampled. Include short modal copy about sampling when >5000 rows.
Sam: Mobile: when heatmap becomes list, keep legend sticky to preserve context. Note perf test.
Alex: Terminology inconsistency: add glossary tooltip for 'Correlation ID vs Trace ID vs Span ID' in header. I'll draft copy.
Maya: I'll update Figma with: darker swatch, numeric anchors, truncated IDs, export modal copy, mobile sticky legend note. Will share updated prototype for final pass. :sparkles:
